# Charlotte Square at the East End

> Luxury one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments at 50 Charlotte Street in Rochester’s
> East End, managed by Evolution24 Properties.

## Facts
- Full name: Charlotte Square at the East End. Usually just "Charlotte Square".
- Address: 50 Charlotte Street, Rochester, NY 14607
- Leasing contact: Vicki Barone, (585) 748-5588
- Managed by: Evolution24 Properties (https://evolution24.net/)
- Built: 2016. 72 apartments across four storeys. LEED-designed with a rooftop solar array.
- Homes: one, two and three bedrooms, roughly 765 to 1,640 square feet.
- Every home has private outdoor space: an oversized terrace on the podium level, a balcony above.
- Included: one space in the secure podium garage, and select utilities. Confirm the exact list with leasing.
- Shared spaces: a terrace with pergola, fire pit and grills on the podium level; a fitness center;
  a community room with a fireplace; a pocket park; secure bike storage; EV charging;
  a soundproof practice room.
- There is no resident roof access. The roof carries the solar array. Older listings that
  describe a "rooftop terrace" are describing the podium-level terrace.
- Neighbourhood: Rochester’s East End. Four businesses share the block: FMR Fitness &
  Wellness, personal training, at 15 Charlotte St; Chick’n Out at 37; and Ugly Duck Coffee
  and Rosebud Retro, a vintage clothing collective, both at 89. Eastman Theatre, The
  Little Theatre and East Avenue are a short walk; the Rochester Public Market is a mile
  north up Union Street. RTS transit and I-490 are minutes away.

- Residents pay rent and file maintenance requests at https://evolution.twa.rentmanager.com/
